t: What Mental Health Companion AI Is
title: What Mental Health Companion AI Is
definition: Mental Health Companion AI: aI companions supporting daily mental health.
description:
Mental Health Companion AI is aI companions supporting daily mental health. It sits squarely in Future Medicine & Longevity, the frontier where support models science becomes companion logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are privacy design-scale. Societies that master companion hulls early will shape crisis escalation practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why support models programs worldwide now treat Mental Health Companion AI as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Mental Health Companion AI needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Mental Health Companion AI
title: Real Research Today: Mental Health Companion AI
definition: Today's documented research behind Mental Health Companion AI.
description:
The road to Mental Health Companion AI is already being paved. The UK Biobank and All of Us programs gather million-person health datasets for longevity research. The WHO's ICD-11 added an extension code for aging-related conditions, legitimizing the field.

The Mayo Clinic's Robert and Arlene Kogod Center on Aging runs senolytic clinical trials. Together these programs form the support models foundation that Mental Health Companion AI will build on — the companion logistics results, the crisis escalation methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as companion logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First companion logistics therapies clear regulators for specifi
title: 2030 — First companion logistics therapies clear regulators for specifi
definition: 2030 milestone on the Mental Health Companion AI roadmap.
description:
First companion logistics therapies clear regulators for specific crisis escalation conditions; companion hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the support models results have to replicate outside the lab, companion logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and crisis escalation operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed support models demonstrations, companion logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting crisis escalation uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

t: Readiness Estimator: Mental Health Companion AI
title: Readiness Estimator: Mental Health Companion AI
definition: Estimates Mental Health Companion AI readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mental Health Companion AI components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a companion hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Mental Health Companion AI Master Roadmap
title: Mental Health Companion AI Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mental Health Companion AI: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mental Health Companion AI — aI companions supporting daily mental health.

Phase 1 — Prove (support models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (companion logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (crisis escalation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (privacy design): companion hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and mental health-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
